original_session_goal: Prevent blocked repository work or missing external tasks from halting StegVerse development by deriving and completing the next admissible work from durable repository state.
claim_release_condition: Issue #118 records validated successor-packet, cross-repository comparison, and archive-queue evidence and parent issue #114 admits or transfers activation ownership.
collision_boundaries: Do not create a second session-orchestration implementation lane.
Do not treat blocked or waiting state as proof that no admissible work exists.
Do not treat generated documentation or a proposed protocol as activated operation.
Do not claim ChatGPT UI archival from repository evidence alone.

goals.name: Governed continuation and repository self-description
goals.origin: Every repository must expose enough durable state for a fresh observer to reconstruct the next admissible work without chat history.
required_locations: successor packet and cross-repository comparison implementation owned by issue #118
goals.archival_dependency: Durable transfer recorded; this session need not own implementation.
goals.next_executable_action: Issue #118 must generate repository-bound successor packets and compare live handoff and ownership records fail closed.

goals.name: Completion intelligence
goals.origin: Continuation must measure whether the admissible frontier is converging rather than expanding indefinitely.
required_locations: archive queue projection owned by issue #118
goals.archival_dependency: Requirement preserved in this inventory and issue #118 coordination.
goals.next_executable_action: Archive-queue generation must expose frontier size, blocked candidates, admitted candidates, and why no candidate is executable.

goals.name: Recursive improvement observations
goals.origin: Repeated blockers, validator defects, and repair patterns must become durable improvement inputs instead of remaining in chat.
required_locations: issue #114 activation receipts and remaining blockers
goals.archival_dependency: Requirement is now durable and owned by the activation workstream.
goals.next_executable_action: Activation receipts must retain recurring failure classes and the next deterministic repair task.

goals.name: Cross-repository ecosystem coherence
goals.origin: Individually valid repositories must not silently diverge from their dependencies, owners, protocol versions, or successor sources.
required_locations: cross-repository handoff and ownership comparison owned by issue #118
goals.archival_dependency: Requirement preserved under the canonical comparison implementation.
goals.next_executable_action: Issue #118 must detect conflicting owners, stale handoffs, unresolved successor sources, and incompatible repository claims.

goals.name: Selection intelligence
goals.origin: The continuation path must distinguish valuable admitted work from obsolete, superseded, duplicate, or nonconvergent work.
required_locations: registry-derived archive queue owned by issue #118
goals.archival_dependency: Requirement preserved; no separate selection subsystem is authorized by this session.
goals.next_executable_action: Queue projection must classify COMPLETE, BLOCKED, RETRY, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAILED, CLAIMED, SUPERSEDED, and MERGED without converting missing evidence to success.

goals.name: Purpose governance
goals.origin: Continuation candidates must preserve the originating goal and show why the work still serves that goal.
required_locations: successor activation packet owned by issue #118
goals.archival_dependency: Requirement preserved as packet provenance rather than a competing new layer.
goals.next_executable_action: Every successor packet must include originating goal, bounded authority, completion conditions, and nonclaims.

goals.name: Intent and continuation authority
goals.origin: Every new objective or successor action must have a reconstructable owner, authority source, delegation boundary, and release condition.
required_locations: successor activation packet and duplicate-owner comparison owned by issue #118
goals.archival_dependency: Requirement preserved in the canonical successor and ownership workstream.
goals.next_executable_action: Issue #118 must bind every successor to repository, branch, task, commit, authority source, claimant, expiration or release condition, collision boundaries, and expected evidence.

goals.name: Session consolidation and elimination
goals.origin: Transfer all unique information and remaining work into durable repository control surfaces so redundant sessions can close safely.
goals.archival_dependency: The inventory, consolidation receipt, handoff entry, and issue coordination record must all exist and resolve.
goals.next_executable_action: Install the consolidation receipt, update the canonical handoff, and record the merge in issues #114 and #118.

archive_condition: All unique requirements are durably represented by this inventory, the consolidation receipt, the canonical handoff, and issue #114/#118 coordination; this session owns no separate implementation lane.
authority_boundary: This inventory transfers requirements and ownership. It does not prove issue #114 activation, issue #118 implementation completion, deployment, publication, or ChatGPT UI archival.
